title: New Bangsamoro Parliament building breaks ground

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The Bangsamoro Transition Authority (BTA) broke ground on Monday for a new 10-story Parliament building inside the Bangsamoro Government Center here, weeks before the region’s first elected legislature takes office. BTA Parliament Speaker Mohammad Yacob led the ceremony with other Parliament officials. The new building will rise on the site of the existing Parliament building, which will be demolished to make way for construction. Khalid Ma-amor Hadji Abdullah, chair of the Committee on Accounts, said the project’s first phase has an allocation of P800 million, with construction expected to be completed within three years.
